project_name: Mahamaya - High-Tech Durga Puja Cultural Experience

theme_identity.archetype: Sacred Luxury & Cyber-Kinetic Art (E1 Anti-AI Fusion)
theme_identity.emotional_tone: Devotional awe, cinematic wonder, high-energy festival warmth, futuristic digital preservation
theme_identity.target_audience: Global travelers, Bengali diaspora, culture enthusiasts, digital art admirers

display_serif.usage: Main H1 headings, chapter titles, mantra verses, hero kinetic reveals

body_sans.usage: Paragraphs, card content, itinerary list, travel tips

tech_mono.usage: Timestamps, map coordinates, 2026 calendar dates, audio frequency display, UI tags

hierarchy_rules.H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-serif

colors.accessibility_rules: All body text must achieve > 4.5:1 APCA contrast ratio. Dark cards must use tinted grey (#161A1D) instead of pure black. Dropdowns and fixed header MUST have dark backdrop opacity with backdrop-blur-xl (never pure transparent).

layout_and_grids.hero_section: Kinetic line reveal with layered 3D particle divine canvas backdrop, audio toggle floating top right, and split editorial manifesto callout
layout_and_grids.bento_grid: Mode A (Tetris Grid) for Pandal showcase & 2026 Puja dates (8-col desktop layout with asymmetric hero cell span-8, tall audio cell span-4)
layout_and_grids.map_layout: Interactive split view: Left pane containing Leaflet/OpenStreetMap with custom nocturnal golden pins; Right pane containing Pandal detail drawer, crowd status & itinerary builder
layout_and_grids.pandal_3d_canvas: Full-bleed interactive WebGL/Three.js or procedural Canvas chamber with click-to-move, 360 camera rotater, pranam flower offering interactive button, and dynamic temple lighting switch

visual_enhancers.dot_matrix_mesh_cursor: Canvas overlay following mouse cursor with interactive dotted matrix particle web (Antigravity-inspired effect with gold/red spring tension)
visual_enhancers.shimmer_tracing_beam: Glowing golden gradient line animated around featured Pandal cards and interactive CTA buttons
visual_enhancers.editorial_marquee: Slow drifting low-contrast serif text running smoothly across section boundaries with react-fast-marquee or framer motion
visual_enhancers.texture_overlay: Subtle noise grain CSS background to eliminate flat digital gradients and mimic traditional terracotta & paper texture

motion_and_interactions.lenis_scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling enabled globally via Lenis for weight and fluidity

framer_motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight scale-up reveal on tab/page change
framer_motion.text_reveal: Masked line-by-line clip path reveal for H1 headlines
framer_motion.card_hover: Hover lift -translate-y-1.5 with golden inner shadow glow

motion_and_interactions.sound_effects: Web Audio API synth or audio sample triggers for button clicks, pranam offerings, and dhak drum tap interactions

pages_and_components.Navbar: Sticky glassmorphism header (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70 border-b border-amber-500/20`), Language Toggle (English/Bengali), Audio Mute/Play Floating Widget, Section Links, 'Explore 3D Pandal' primary CTA
pages_and_components.HeroSection: Large kinetic title 'MAHAMAYA 2026' with subline 'The Sovereign Divine Awakening of Kolkata', line-by-line reveal animation, interactive dot matrix canvas, quick stats (3000+ Pandals, 5 Days of Magic), CTA buttons with golden tracing beam
pages_and_components.StorytellingSection: Interactive Mahishasuramardini Chapter Flow (Origin of Chandi, Creation of 10 Weapons, War with Mahishasura, Victory & Immersion) + Live AI Story Generator powered by Emergent API
pages_and_components.PandalExplorerMap: Interactive OpenStreetMap (Leaflet.js) centered at Kolkata with dark nocturnal styling, search by area (North Kolkata / South Kolkata / Salt Lake), filter by UNESCO heritage vs modern theme, itinerary pin saver
pages_and_components.Pandal3DSimulator: Interactive 3D Pandal Walkthrough with 360-degree virtual view, step-inside camera zoom, light/dark mood toggle, flower offering (Pranam) animation counter, and audio mantra play
pages_and_components.MusicSanctum: Audio player with Bengali Puja song playlists, interactive Dhak drum simulator keyboard, and traditional Aarti soundboard
pages_and_components.GallerySection: Filterable image grid (Traditional Pandals, Lighting Art, Dhaki Performers, Idol Sculpting) with full-screen lightbox, zoom, and location tag
pages_and_components.PujaCalendar2026: Interactive 2026 Date Guide (Maha Sasthi Oct 16 to Maha Dashami Oct 20, 2026), daily rituals breakdown, tourist survival tips, emergency contacts, local street food recommendations

instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Tailwind CSS with Lucide React icons, Framer Motion for micro-interactions, Leaflet/React-Leaflet for maps
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, language switcher, audio controls, map markers, form inputs) MUST include a clear kebab-case data-testid attribute. E.g., data-testid='language-toggle-btn', data-testid='pandal-map-search-input', data-testid='enter-3d-pandal-btn'.
instructions_to_main_agent.responsive_rules: Ensure mobile-first layout with smooth touch controls. Mobile images must not exceed max-h-[80vh].

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop: Use rich vermilion red, antique gold accents, dark obsidian background, and high-contrast typography.
Do NOT use pure transparent background in dropdowns, headers, or overlays. Always use dark backdrop opacity with backdrop-blur-xl.
Do NOT apply transition: all globally. Add specific transitions like transition-colors or transition-transform.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, audio toggles, map markers, and cards contain data-testid attributes.
Provide seamless toggling between English and Bengali UI labels across all sections.
